input.headline: Henderson leads Chelsea rout while Haaland keeps scoring for captains

cards.text: Haaland found the net again at Liverpool, but managers who handed the armband to João Pedro instead banked double the reward.

cards.title: Matches that mattered
cards.text: Henderson (18 points) and João Pedro (12 points) ran riot for Chelsea. At Liverpool, Doku (12 points) and Cherki (10 points) shone for Man City.

cards.title: The big hauls
cards.text: The gameweek's top scorer was in almost nobody's squad, while De Cuyper rewarded the 687,683 managers who bought him.
Groß delivered a modest assist for his new owners, while the sellers of Tzolis and Szoboszlai were spared a blank.
